Things found while real life testing (#79)

* Add noise filtering for power detection

Use median filtering for VSYS readings, debounce VBUS, and add 0.1V
hysteresis to suppress display flicker. Add moving_median dependency and
document the strategy in README

* Do not stop sound on standby, fixes race condition after going out of
standby

* Issue with not playing sound after standby and after alarms that had
quit by the end of the song: Race of pending sound stop signal. Solution
is to track DFPlayer power state and gate stop signal to only when it is
even powered.

* Add ClockTime and avoid redundant LED writes

* Bump version to 0.7.2 and add lessons learned

* Use PIN_15 for WS2812 instead of PIN_19

* Add Neopixel power control and state handle

Use PIN_14 to control Neopixel power and pass an explicit NeopixelHandle
through effects. Ensure proper power-on/off sequencing with small delays
and update alarm brightness default to 7.

* Initialize Neopixel in main and pass to task

* Move Neopixel control pin from GPIO19 to GPIO15, introduce power
management for Neopixel via GPIO14 and another IRLZ44N.

* Reduce divider impedance and update ADC scaling

Lower impedance voltage dividers and add decoupling/filter caps:
- R9,R11: 680k -> 100k; R10,R12: 1M -> 200k
- Add R14 and R13 grouping changes to resistor table
- Add C5 and ADC filter caps C8,C9; update capacitor table Update power
  reader to use divider ratio 3.0 (was 2.47) and revise README
  noise-filtering text accordingly

* Correct GPIO nets, update placements and values

Rename GPIO nets (GP14/GP15/GP19) and Q2 nets; adjust pad pintypes.
Reposition multiple footprints and update silk/fab layers. Change
resistor values (1M -> 200K, 680k -> 100K). Add PCB .stl step file, plus
GND symbols and a 100nF decoupling cap.

* Update src/task/power.rs

Fix hangs (#75)

Refactored event-driven async operations into direct function calls to reduce event queue overhead and potential race conditions.

Key changes:
- Removed six event variants and replaced event-based communication with direct handler calls
- Added interruptible cooldown mechanism in alarm trigger task
- Improved analog clock update interval from 3740ms to 1000ms

More setup options (#74)

* Add system settings, UI and persistence

Introduce SystemSettings (volume, clock brightness) with flash
persistence (keys 3-4) and runtime propagation.

Add UI modes for Settings / SetVolume / SetClockBrightness /
SetTimeManual, display rendering and button handlers. Provide runtime
update signals for NeoPixel brightness and DFPlayer volume, and a manual
RTC-set helper. Refactor settings persistence task to handle both alarm
and system values.

* Add interactive auto-timeout with auto-save

Introduce InteractiveModeTimeout event and last_interaction_tick in
SystemState. Button presses refresh the tick. Scheduler checks
inactivity every second and dispatches the timeout event. Timeout
handler auto-saves pending changes (volume, brightness, alarm time,
manual time) and returns to Normal mode. Bump firmware to v0.3 and
document auto-timeout in README

Test build (#72)

* Add RTC manager and initialization flow

Replace the global RTC mutex with a dedicated rtc_manager task that owns
the RTC and exposes async APIs. Update time_updater, scheduler, display,
and alarm_trigger to use the manager. Add Initializing mode and
SystemReady event to coordinate RTC/time and alarm-settings startup;
display an initializing screen and keep LEDs off until ready. Ensure
alarms are always scheduled in the future and improve alarm wait/
scheduling logic. Misc: always send alarm-settings event (use defaults
if missing), apply quintic easing to LED transitions, and reduce system
clock to 10 MHz.

* pcb and schemativ v0.2: Fix ground bounce by providing direct path to
battery ground

* Use global signals and mutex for RTC API responses

Replace per-request oneshot channels with shared Signals and serialize
callers with RTC_API_MUTEX to avoid responses being stolen. Simplify
RtcRequest variants to not carry senders and adapt handlers to
reset/signal responses and use timeouts.

* Display firmware version on system info

Add a FIRMWARE_VERSION static and show it in the system info view.
Remove unused battery voltage getters and update the display function
signature and call site accordingly.

Reposition value labels in schematic

and rotation of value labels for BTN GREEN, BTN YELLOW, BTN BLUE, and
IRLZ44N.

Sober up warnings (#65)

* Run all tasks on main executor

Remove the high-priority InterruptExecutor, SWI_IRQ_1 handler, and the
core1 spawn. Use the single main spawner for all tasks (including
light_effects). Update imports accordingly (use defmt::info and drop
interrupt/multicore types).

* Suppress Clippy warnings in build.rs

* Add package metadata to Cargo.toml

* Reorder task_messages imports

* Update main.rs

* Use brace formatting and add docs in build.rs

* Make DateTime formatting non-panicking and borrowed

Change convert_datetime_to_str to take &DateTime and avoid unwraps;
ignore padding failures so capacity errors skip padding instead of
panicking. Add a doc comment for StringUtils and update docs to use
backticks for types. Tweak day-of-week mapping and add a small clippy
allow for the padding calculation.

* Unify button handlers into single handler

* Improve alarm settings flash handling and messages

Return None when flash read fails; avoid panics and emit warnings
instead of panicking. Use Option buffer for fetched values, log reads,
and continue trying to store other values on write failures. Make
PersistedAlarmSettings::new const and refine its fields. Handle missing
settings at startup and warn on unexpected commands. Also fix a datetime
borrow in display, derive Clone for Events, and add a SOUND_STOP_SIGNAL
doc comment.

* Refactor light effects into modular helpers

Introduce NUM_LEDS_USIZE/NUM_LEDS and a NeopixelType alias, add
ClockColors and SunriseParams, and extract display_analog_clock,
sunrise_effect, noise_effect, turn_off_all_leds, and related helpers.
Use const constructors/getters, safer color math, narrower defmt
imports, and simplify state handling in the main task.

* Refactor orchestrator event handling

* Use Ticker for adaptive scheduler timing

Start with a default Ticker and recreate it when the alarm enabled state
changes so the scheduler can switch between short and long update
periods. Wait on ticker.next() or the wake signal instead of a Timer.

* Handle ADC read failures and use f32::from

Guard ADC processing on successful read and convert the ADC sample via
f32::from to avoid lossy casts. Also replace defmt::* with defmt::info
to limit imports.

* Make many methods const, add docs and Eq derives

- Fix alarm stop button sequence check to use iter().all - Use f32
ranges for battery percentage and avoid premature cast - Change
save_alarm_settings to take &self and import defmt::Format - Simplify
StateManager::new and merge Menu/SystemInfo toggle logic

* Make StateManager constructors and mutators const

Also simplify match arms to single-line expressions and remove
unnecessary braces/semicolons

* Refine DFPlayer comments, timing, and types

Add inline docs for DFPlayer/MyTimeSource, reduce power-on delay from 1s
to 500ms, and remove explicit u64 casts when passing as_millis() values.
Remove an outdated feedback comment.

* Add Eq to Commands and document signals

Derive Eq for the Commands enum to allow equality checks. Add new
SCHEDULER_START_SIGNAL and SCHEDULER_WAKE_SIGNAL and improve doc
comments (use backticks) for vsys_voltage_reader and scheduler signals.
Remove an obsolete TODO comment.

* Update display.rs

Refactor display task and improve error handling

* Refactor time_updater task and docs

Add structured TimeUpdater with const defaults
(SSID/PASSWORD/TIME_SERVER_URL). Improve documentation and field
comments, tighten error handling (expect instead of unwrap), adjust DHCP
config creation, match join and set_datetime results, and add clippy
allowances for large stack buffers.

* Refactor time_updater into modular WiFi/HTTP/RTC

Extract WiFi and network setup, connection, HTTP fetch, JSON parsing,
and RTC update into separate functions. Add static cells for CYW43
state, network stack/resources, and reusable HttpBuffers; use a
heapless::String for response handling. Improve timeout/error handling,
retry flow, and overall clarity of the time updater task

* Use wrapping add for wheel index

* Update config filename in time_updater docs

* Remove DHCP wait loops in time updater

Use rtc alarm (#64)

* Configure defmt release logging and update README

Document DEFMT_LOG usage in README and add a defmt release profile to
compile out debug/info logs; recommend DEFMT_LOG=warn to prevent RTT
buffer overflow when running standalone

* Add RTC alarm trigger task and refactor scheduler

Introduce task/alarm_trigger.rs to schedule and await RTC alarms and add
ALARM_SCHEDULE_UPDATE_SIGNAL / ALARM_SCHEDULE_DISABLE_SIGNAL for
coordination. Move alarm scheduling/triggering out of scheduler;
scheduler now relies on the RTC and uses alarm_enabled to determine
update frequency. Downgrade several non-fatal error logs to warn where
initialization/timeouts are recoverable.

* Update src/task/alarm_trigger.rs
